newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes strike in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes strike in Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli planes rocketed suspected Hizbollah guerrillas targets in south Lebanon on Sunday, security sources said.
They said two Israeli planes fired two rockets into the hills of Jabal Safi and Mleeta in the Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridge -- a bastion of the Moslem guerrillas.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air raid -- the 37th into Lebanon since the beginning of the year.
Earlier on Sunday, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah said its guerrillas attacked an Israeli outpost inside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone with machinguns and rocket-propelled grenades.
There was no immediate confirmation of the attack on the Sojoud outpost from inside the zone.
Hizbollah fights Israeli troops to oust them from the 15-km (nine-mile) -wide occupation zone.
